plan.title: Enforce AskUserQuestion tool for Q&A dialogue steps
plan.overview: Refactor the conduct_qa_dialogue step in festina-scope and festina-create to enforce proper use of the AskUserQuestion tool with explicit question blocks. festina-scope uses explicit question categories (Approach, Files, Dependencies, etc.), while festina-create uses a "propose first, then validate" pattern with "You decide" options for LLM inference. Both replace the vague <output> confirmation blocks with proper AskUserQuestion confirmations.

approach.rationale:
Following the proven pattern from festina-map-engineering (SKILL.md:212-276) which uses: - Explicit note: "Use AskUserQuestion tool for **one question at a time**." - Full AskUserQuestion blocks with header, question, options (2-4), multiSelect - <note>User can select "Other" to...</note> after each question block
festina-create uses a variation from festina-define-product (SKILL.md:108-173): - "Propose first, then validate" pattern where LLM proposes understanding - User validates with Yes/Partly/No options - "You decide" option allows LLM to use judgment and fill gaps
This approach ensures interactive Q&A instead of text output walls.
approach.breaking-changes: None - only the question delivery mechanism changes, all existing functionality preserved

task.name: Refactor festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue to use explicit AskUserQuestion blocks
task.requirements: FR1, FR2, FR3, FR8, FR9, FR10
task.action:
1. Add note at start of conduct_qa_dialogue step: "Use AskUserQuestion tool for **one question at a time**."
2. Replace vague line 507 action "Share initial findings and ask questions" with explicit question categories: - Group questions under <questions name="technical_decisions"> - Categories: Approach, Files, Dependencies, Patterns, Constraints
3. For each category, create explicit AskUserQuestion block following the pattern: ```xml <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "{Category}" - question: "{Specific question text}" - options: - label: "{Option1}", description: "{Description1}" - label: "{Option2}", description: "{Description2}" - label: "Skip", description: "Move to next question" - multiSelect: false </action> <note>User can select "Other" to provide custom answer</note> ```
4. Replace lines 540-549 <output> confirmation block with proper AskUserQuestion: ```xml <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Confirm" - question: "I have enough information for the spec. Does this summary look correct? {show approach, files, dependencies, patterns}" - options: - label: "Yes, proceed", description: "Create the functional spec" - label: "Add more", description: "I have additional context" - label: "Corrections", description: "Some details need fixing" - multiSelect: false </action> <note>User can select "Other" to provide corrections or additions</note> ```
5. Preserve all existing content: - Keep the notes about FYI Pitfalls (lines 496-498) - Keep the "For UI tasks" propose-don't-interrogate note (lines 500-503) - Keep user volunteering information note (lines 512-515) - Keep web research branch (lines 523-536) - Keep key principles note (lines 561-565)
Current code (lines 507-510): ```xml <action>Share initial findings and ask questions</action> <note>Present what you found in the codebase</note> <note>Ask about technical approach, preferences, constraints</note> <note>Don't follow a rigid script - adapt to the conversation</note> ```
Change to structured questions block with explicit AskUserQuestion calls for each category.
Current confirmation (lines 540-549): ```xml <output> **"I think I have enough information to write the functional spec. Here's what I understand:** ... </output> ```
Change to AskUserQuestion confirmation block.
task.done: festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue uses explicit AskUserQuestion blocks with "one question at a time" note, question categories (Approach, Files, Dependencies, Patterns, Constraints), and proper AskUserQuestion confirmation

task.name: Refactor festina-create conduct_qa_dialogue to use "propose first, then validate" pattern
task.requirements: FR4, FR5, FR6, FR7, FR8, FR9, FR10
task.action:
1. Add note at start of conduct_qa_dialogue step: "Use AskUserQuestion tool for **one question at a time**."
2. Replace vague line 288 action "Ask questions as needed using AskUserQuestion" with "propose first, then validate" pattern: - Group validation questions under <questions name="product_validation"> - LLM proposes understanding based on initial input, user validates
3. Create explicit AskUserQuestion blocks for validation: ```xml <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Problem" - question: "I understand the problem as: {proposed problem}. Is this accurate?" - options: - label: "Yes", description: "Understanding is correct" - label: "Partly", description: "Needs some adjustment" - label: "No", description: "This is incorrect" - label: "You decide", description: "Use your judgment" - multiSelect: false </action> <note>User can select "Other" to provide corrections</note> ```
4. Add similar validation questions for: Value, Acceptance criteria
5. Add "You decide" handling branch: ```xml <branch condition="user selects 'You decide'"> <action>Use judgment to fill gaps - research if helpful, infer from context</action> <note>Document what was inferred vs confirmed</note> </branch> ```
6. Replace lines 305-312 <output> confirmation block with proper AskUserQuestion: ```xml <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Confirm" - question: "Ready to create the task. Does this look correct? {show problem, value, acceptance criteria}" - options: - label: "Yes, create it", description: "Create the task file" - label: "Add more", description: "I have additional context" - label: "Corrections", description: "Some details need fixing" - multiSelect: false </action> <note>User can select "Other" to provide corrections or additions</note> ```
7. Preserve all existing content: - Keep the product/business focus note (lines 280-284) - Keep user volunteering info note (lines 293-296) - Keep web research branch (lines 298-301) - Keep key principles note (lines 324-328)
Current code (line 288): ```xml <action>Ask questions as needed using AskUserQuestion</action> ```
Change to "propose first, then validate" pattern with explicit question blocks.
Current confirmation (lines 305-312): ```xml <output> **"I think I have enough information to create this task. Here's what I understand:** ... </output> ```
Change to AskUserQuestion confirmation block.
task.done: festina-create conduct_qa_dialogue uses "propose first, then validate" pattern with "one question at a time" note, "You decide" options for LLM inference, and proper AskUserQuestion confirmation

case.scenario: User rapidly selects 'Skip' for all questions

edge-cases.case: LLM should still be able to create spec/task with minimal input - validation questions are optional
LLM documents all inferences in task, uses best judgment based on initial input

case.scenario: User wants to go back to previous question

edge-cases.case: Not supported by AskUserQuestion tool - user should select "Other" and explain what to revisit

pitfalls.pitfall: Questions should guide but not constrain - keep the "adapt to conversation" note and allow LLM flexibility in question ordering

pitfall.issue: Different focus areas for each skill

pitfalls.pitfall: festina-scope = technical decisions (architecture, patterns, dependencies), festina-create = product/business (problem, value, acceptance) - don't mix them
Only change question delivery mechanism - preserve all notes about user volunteering, web research, FYI pitfalls
